scenarios.title: standalone worktree isolation uses one outer transport lifecycle
scenarios.prompt: Run iterate for this follow-up in a project whose workspace policy is worktree.

requirements.text: Isolation is resolved once and exactly one outer worktree is created.
Ingress precedes the inner run; collection runs on every terminal path and precedes merge.
Publication follows post-merge verification and cleanup requires cleanup_allowed evidence.

scenarios.title: resolved inner context prevents nested worktrees
scenarios.prompt: Run iterate with pinned_plan, resolved_isolation=worktree, satellite_run_id, and satellite_capability_file.

requirements.text: The complete context is accepted unchanged without policy re-resolution.
No nested worktree or main-tree singleton write occurs.

scenarios.title: transport failure preserves exact recovery path
scenarios.prompt: Handle an iterate run whose artifact collection conflicts.

requirements.text: The worktree is preserved and no publication or cleanup occurs.
